messages:
sanjay: heads up — after last night's AD sync we have a small spike in permission drift reports from a couple customers :rotating_light:
emma: which customers? any common pattern?
sanjay: acme-inc and beta-ops. both had an Azure AD group split during their tenant migration. SCIM shows duplicate group entries with different externalIds. some role bindings now point at the old group GUIDs
oliver: are those GUIDs still present in our datastore or were they soft-deleted?
sanjay: soft-deleted in scim/groups table, but RBAC bindings referencing them weren't cleaned. deprovisioner didn't remove because external_id mismatch.
emma: can you paste a sample binding?
sanjay: ```binding: {id: rb-54321, principal_type: group, principal_ref: "group:azure:3f2a-OLD", role: editor, source: scim, created_at: 1767500000}```
emma: ok. looks like the provisioner matched on externalId earlier but now group was recreated with new externalId after split. deprovisioner checks tombstone+external_id; it missed the old one
kai: provisioner-bot just posted a reconcile job failure 00:12 with this error: "conflict on unique key (external_id)" — maybe the split caused a duplicate external_id insertion attempt
provisioner-bot: automated: ran scim-reconcile for tenant acme-inc (dry-run). orphaned_bindings=7, potential_kms_principals=2
oliver: kms impact?
sanjay: two KMS grants still include the old group principal name (aws:kms:principal:group:3f2a-OLD). those principals no longer map to an active group object in scim API, but IAM still grants keys to that principal name — we should treat as risk.
emma: possible short-term mitigation: rotate affected keys and update grants to point to canonical new group principal. longer-term: fix deprovisioner reconciliation to use GUID lineage mapping (keep old_external_id -> new mapping) or fallback to tombstone TTL scan
kai: agree. also need to update audit trail: last SCIM events for the affected groups show only create events for new GUIDs and a delete for old GUIDs but no linking event. looks like Azure AD split returns both groups and we created the new one without preserving previous extId map
oliver: quick action items: 1) run full reconcile non-dry for acme-inc with prune flag 2) identify bindings referencing absent groups 3) rotate kms keys + regrant to new group principal 4) ship a small fix to provisioner reconcile that treats displayName+tenant heuristics as fallback mapping for 7 days
sanjay: I'll queue the non-dry reconcile now. running: `./bin/provisioner reconcile --tenant acme-inc --prune-orphans --yes`
sanjay: results: orphaned_bindings_removed=5, remaining_orphans=2 (manual inspect).
emma: which two?
sanjay: rb-54321 and rb-54329. both are 'editor' roles on infra project.
kai: grabbing audit logs for those bindings and cross-checking with KMS grants
provisioner-bot: automated: created issue #ID-987 for manual review of remaining orphaned bindings
oliver: for the KMS keys: suggest immediate rotation and regrant. who's oncall for keyops? @emma?
emma: I'm available. I'll schedule rotation window and notify customers. also we'll add a temporary rule in console to hide orphaned bindings from UI until reconciled to avoid confusion
sanjay: for the code fix: proposal: during scim-fed reconciliation, if external_id mismatch but displayName and member hashes match above 75% threshold, treat as lineage and migrate bindings. fallback window 14 days.\ai: (note: not a person)
oliver: implement as small migration that writes a mapping table old_group_guid -> new_group_guid with TTL 30d. make migration idempotent. add tests for split/merge scenarios.
kai: I found two KMS grants referencing the old principal: key-aaaa and key-bbbb. policy statements: ```{"Principal":"group:azure:3f2a-OLD","Actions":["kms:Decrypt"]}```. I'll open KeyOps change and schedule rotation.
emma: customer notification draft: "We detected transient permission discrepancies related to an identity provider group split during your tenant migration. We removed stale bindings and rotated any affected encryption keys. No unauthorized access detected. Contact support if you see issues."
sanjay: postmortem checklist: timeline of AD sync, reconcile runs, manual actions, code fix PR, deploy, and customer comms. assign owner for follow-up: oliver -> code fix, emma -> customer comms + key rotation, kai -> audit + KMS changes, sanjay -> reconcile + manual cleanup
oliver: I'll open PR with tests and put it in the 2-day hotfix lane.
emma: I'll notify support and prepare a release note.
provisioner-bot: automated: deploy pipeline queued for branch hotfix/scim-lineage. status: pending review
sanjay: thanks everyone. please add any missed items here. tagging for visibility: @security @platform @keyops
kai: quick follow-up — we should add metrics for orphaned_bindings_count per-tenant and an alert when >3 within 24h. will create alert rule after this stabilizes
oliver: agreed. also add signal for scim-unique-key-conflicts in logs
emma: good, keep me posted on rotations. I'll draft the customer note and send once keys rotated
provisioner-bot: automated: reconcile non-dry completed at 1767604600. final_orphans=0.
sanjay: closing this thread, will start postmortem doc in #incident-docs. thanks :thumbsup:
